summary: Iteration 147 — Wrap Command Center Phase 2E both-side testing. BACKEND 24/24 PASS (test_iteration147_wrap_phase2e.py, 11.6s). FRONTEND 100% of review_request flows verified PASS on viewport 1920x1100 with admin thesigntistslab@gmail.com. BACKEND COVERAGE: GET /api/wrap/items/{id} returns top-level inspection and aftercare blocks with all required fields (legacy auto-backfill via _serialize). PUT /api/wrap/items/{id}/inspection persists subset fields (inspection_status, vehicle_diagram_type, inspected_by, inspection_date, inspection_notes) using exclude_unset. customer_acknowledged=true mirrors to approvals.inspection_acknowledged=true with timestamp AND auto-flips inspection_status='acknowledged' AND pipeline_state.inspection_complete becomes true. Setting customer_acknowledged=false clears inspection.customer_acknowledged_at, approvals.inspection_acknowledged=false, and approvals.inspection_acknowledged_at=null. Invalid inspection_status returns 400 with allowed list. inspection_status='in_progress' sets pipeline_state.inspection_active=true / inspection_complete=false. Damage marker CRUD: POST returns the wrap doc with new marker (id, area, damage_type, severity, photo_placeholder, notes, created_at, created_by); PUT merges subset fields preserving untouched ones; invalid damage_type / severity returns 400 with allowed list; DELETE removes; PUT on non-existent marker returns 404. PUT /api/wrap/items/{id}/aftercare: subset persistence works (aftercare_status, aftercare_template, sent_by, aftercare_notes). Invalid aftercare_status returns 400. aftercare_sent=true auto-stamps aftercare_sent_at, auto-flips aftercare_status='sent' (when previously not_sent/generated), AND mirrors to approvals.aftercare_sent=true with its own _at timestamp. Idempotent: 2nd PUT with aftercare_sent=true preserves the original aftercare_sent_at (verified via 2 sequential calls, ts unchanged). customer_viewed=true stamps customer_viewed_at, flips status to 'viewed' (from sent/not_sent/generated). customer_acknowledged=true stamps customer_acknowledged_at, flips status to 'acknowledged' (when not already in complete/followup_active). followup_24h/_7d/_30d each set their own boolean + {fk}_at timestamp on first activation; idempotent (2nd true preserves ts); false clears the ts to null. pipeline_state.workflow_complete becomes true only when install_complete + complete (final_signoff) + aftercare_complete are all true (verified with combined PUT setting install.install_status='complete'+customer_signoff=true triggering 2D conjunctive auto-flip, then aftercare_sent=true). Production Board mirror (GET /api/production-tasks/board) returns at most ONE row with job_ticket_id=wrap_ticket and source='wrap_command_center' across all stages even after multiple production_status PUTs (printing→ready_for_install) — _sync_wrap_to_production_board is idempotent. Non-wrap guard returns 400 'not a wrap category' on all 5 Phase 2E endpoints (PUT /inspection, POST/PUT/DELETE damage-markers, PUT /aftercare). No mongo _id leakage across any Phase 2E response (recursive check). Phase 2A/B/C/D regression smoke: GET returns all expected blocks (vehicle_info, wrapped_areas, materials, pricing, design, contract, approvals, production, install, inspection, aftercare, pipeline_state, coverage_summary); POST /recalculate still returns pricing_snapshot with quoted_price. FRONTEND: Logged in successfully and loaded /orders/118b7377-.../items/aa0387f8-.../wrap-command-center. INSPECTION TAB (wrap-tab-inspection): all 8 controls render (insp-select-status, insp-select-diagram, insp-input-inspected_by, insp-input-date, insp-input-notes, insp-add-marker-btn, insp-save-btn, insp-toggle-customer_acknowledged). Editing fires insp-unsaved-indicator; insp-save-btn persists and clears indicator. Damage marker add flow: insp-add-marker-btn opens add form (insp-marker-add-area/type/severity/notes/submit); submitting appends a row with insp-marker-row-{id} + insp-marker-edit-btn-{id} + insp-marker-delete-btn-{id}; 2 markers visible after add. Toggling insp-toggle-customer_acknowledged on shows insp-ack-at timestamp (5/18/2026, 1:37:13 AM in screenshot). AFTERCARE TAB (wrap-tab-aftercare): all 11 controls render (aftercare-select-status, aftercare-input-template, aftercare-input-sent_by, aftercare-input-notes, aftercare-save-btn, aftercare-toggle-sent, aftercare-toggle-viewed, aftercare-toggle-acknowledged, aftercare-toggle-followup_24h/_7d/_30d). Editing fires aftercare-unsaved-indicator; aftercare-save-btn persists. aftercare-toggle-sent click immediately shows aftercare-sent-at timestamp. aftercare-toggle-followup_24h click shows aftercare-ts-followup_24h timestamp. AI ASSISTANT TAB (wrap-tab-ai): ai-job-health-status, ai-next-action-label, ai-suggested-action, ai-profit-risk-text, ai-comms-list (3 buttons), ai-quicklinks-grid (9 quicklinks) all render with rule-based summaries — no LLM call. AI helper buttons across all tabs remain placeholder/toast-only per spec. OVERVIEW TAB (wrap-tab-overview): reads real wrap_data — verified live values: QUOTED=$2,037.60, BALANCE=$2,037.60, Wrap Type='vehicle wrap', Vehicle '2023 Mercedes Sprinter / Cargo / High Roof / Silver', Total Raw=180.00 ft², Total Billable=207.00 ft², Included Areas=3, Quoted Price=$2,037.60, Estimated Profit=$585.60, Estimated Margin=28.7%, Pricing Method='material labor markup', Questionnaire='sent', Proof='approved', Current Status='Complete', Next Best Action='Wrap workflow complete' (after the workflow_complete test left state with install_status=complete + customer_signoff=true + aftercare_sent=true). Pipeline chips visible (Measurements/Estimate/Quote Sent/Contract Sent/Contract Signed/Deposit Paid/Approved/Production/Inspection/Install/Aftercare/Complete) — emerald on completed steps, violet on active. No new dashboard/module — WrapCommandCenterPage reachable only via OrderDetail.js triggers (route /orders/:orderId/items/:ticketId/wrap-command-center). Console only minor 404 noise unrelated to wrap flow.
critical_code_review_comments: wrap.py is now 1975 lines — far past the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routes/wrap/{models,helpers,measurements,pricing,design,contract,production,install,inspection,aftercare}.py before Phase 2F. Reading & maintaining is becoming difficult — same recommendation surfaced in iterations 145/146.

_pipeline_state aftercare_complete is set to True the moment aftercare_sent=true (or approvals.aftercare_sent=true). Per the spec this is acceptable for workflow_complete but consider a stricter rule (e.g. aftercare_status=='complete') if business wants the 24h/7d/30d follow-ups closed before declaring workflow complete. Currently a single Send marks the entire aftercare leg done.
InspectionUpdate model is missing a damage_markers field — intentional since markers go through their own POST/PUT/DELETE endpoints. Good separation.

AftercareUpdate exposes 10 sibling fields (status/template/sent_by/sent/viewed/acknowledged/aftercare_notes + 3 followups). Pattern matches InstallUpdate; could be grouped into nested sub-models for symmetry but functional.

_sync_wrap_to_production_board correctly uses (tenant_id, job_ticket_id, source='wrap_command_center') as the upsert key — guarantees a single mirror row and never collides with non-wrap PB tasks. Verified by Board GET returning ≤1 wrap-CC row after multiple status flips.

Inspection acknowledged auto-flip to inspection_status='acknowledged' is unconditional — if a user later changes the status manually back to 'in_progress' while ack=true, the status change persists but customer_acknowledged stays true. Probably acceptable but a tiny edge case worth a UX note.

Damage marker DELETE always returns 200 with the wrap doc, even when marker_id doesn't exist (silent no-op via $pull). Most other endpoints 404 on missing — for consistency consider 404 here too. Non-blocking.

AI Assistant tab is rule-based (summaryHelpers.js) with zero LLM dispatch — confirmed by review_request as intentional placeholder. No backend hits observed for any ai-comm-* or ai-quicklink-* buttons.
No mongo _id leakage anywhere across Phase 2E responses (recursive check passes).
All 5 Phase 2E endpoints correctly enforce non-wrap guard via _load_ticket_or_404 (returns 400 'not a wrap category').

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2E (Inspection + Aftercare + Overview + AI Assistant + Production Board light mirror) is fully wired and verified. wrap_data Mongo doc now stores `inspection` (status, vehicle_diagram_type, inspected_by, inspection_date, customer_acknowledged + _at, inspection_notes, damage_markers[]) and `aftercare` (status, template, sent_by, aftercare_sent + _at, customer_viewed + _at, customer_acknowledged + _at, aftercare_notes, followup_24h/_7d/_30d + each _at). pipeline_state derives inspection_active (in {in_progress, completed}), inspection_complete (status=='acknowledged' OR approvals.inspection_acknowledged), aftercare_active (in {generated, sent, viewed, followup_active}), aftercare_complete (aftercare_sent OR approvals.aftercare_sent), workflow_complete (install_complete AND complete AND aftercare_complete). Mirror rules: customer_acknowledged on inspection → approvals.inspection_acknowledged. aftercare_sent → approvals.aftercare_sent. Auto-status flips: inspection.customer_acknowledged=true → inspection_status='acknowledged'. aftercare_sent=true (when prev in {not_sent,generated}) → aftercare_status='sent'. customer_viewed=true (when prev in {sent,not_sent,generated}) → aftercare_status='viewed'. customer_acknowledged=true (when prev NOT in {complete,followup_active}) → aftercare_status='acknowledged'. Damage marker fields: id, area, damage_type, severity, photo_placeholder, notes, created_at, created_by. DAMAGE_TYPES = {Dent, Scratch, Rust, Paint Chip, Clear Coat Failure, Loose Trim, Cracked Part, Previous Wrap, Adhesive Residue, Other Concern}. SEVERITIES = {Low, Medium, High, Severe}. INSPECTION_STATUSES = {not_started, in_progress, completed, acknowledged}. AFTERCARE_STATUSES = {not_sent, generated, sent, viewed, acknowledged, followup_active, complete}. Production Board mirror is keyed by (tenant_id, job_ticket_id, source='wrap_command_center') — idempotent upsert with stage mapping (intake/production/finishing/ready).
